_readme: FIXED source set for the prompt regression suite. Each entry is a real video that represents a failure CLASS we have actually shipped a bug on. Do not remove one because it passes — a passing source is the proof a class is still safe. Add a source when a NEW class of failure is found in production.
_motionScale: motion = mean frame-to-frame absolute difference, 64x112 grayscale, 0-255. Measured by build-fixtures.js from the local mp4. Real Instagram sources measured 2026-09-04 span 0.86 (a held shot) to 9.92 (a busy street).

sources.why: THE freeze case (2026-09-04). Subject stands by a car; the only real motion is a body crossing the lens in the foreground and a step down. The accuracy guard's 'keep background people incidental' had no lower bound, so the prompt came back demanding 'completely static ... nearly still' and the recreate rendered a 9s frozen frame (motion 0.149 vs the source's 0.862). This source exists to make that impossible to ship again.
Second-lowest measured source. Guards against tuning the motion rules to cosanostra specifically — a fix that only works on one low-motion video is not a fix.

Sits in the middle of the measured range. Catches a rule that over-corrects — if a motion fix starts inventing action on a merely-calm source, it shows up here before it reaches the busy sources where extra motion hides.

sources.class: walk toward camera, high-end lane; SLOWED-DOWN source (slow-mo edit, 'Mega Slowed' track)
sources.why: The control from 2026-09-04: same hour, same persona, same prompt build as the freeze case, and it came out fine (kept 63% of source motion vs 17%). It is the reference for what a healthy recreate looks like. ALSO the 2026-09-05 tempo case: the source is a slowed-down edit, and the prompt came back with 'slowly pulls the sunglasses down… deliberate, unhurried' — Seedance rendered that as playback slow motion at a length that already matched the source (9.97s → 10.04s). Guards the tempo-word ban.

sources.class: talking head, long (>15s), object in hand
sources.why: Three classes at once: real speech (transcript path + the talking-head flag), 21.6s so it crosses the >15s duration branch, and a product held in frame — the beat class the perfume-spray miss belonged to (2026-09-03).

The video the ACCURACY OVER EMBELLISHMENT guard was written for (2026-09-02): the prompt was inflating one admiring glance into a phone-filming paparazzi crowd. Highest measured motion. If a future motion fix loosens that guard too far, the crowd filler comes back HERE first.
The only female-persona source. Guards the PRONOUN rule (she/her, never they/them) and confirms the appearance ban holds on a female persona too.
